name: dsmc_validation_suite
description: Top-level validation suite registry. Individual cases can be summarized independently or run in sequence.

cases.name: lj_argon_baseline
cases.purpose: Classical LJ/Argon baseline against LAMMPS with RDF, S(k), NVE drift, speed distribution, and MSD.

cases.name: enskog_hard_sphere
cases.purpose: Hard-sphere/Enskog DSMC validation for EOS, collision frequency, anisotropy relaxation, and runtime scaling.

cases.name: lj_state_grid
cases.purpose: Multi-state LJ reduced-unit grid over density and temperature with LAMMPS references.

cases.name: transport_nonequilibrium
cases.purpose: Non-equilibrium transport validation: diffusion, viscosity, heat conduction, and Couette/thermal-gradient cases.

cases.name: relativistic_ideal_gas
cases.purpose: Relativistic and ultrarelativistic limits: ideal EOS, Juttner-like momentum distribution, and stress tensor checks.
